# `similar-descriptions`

**Page rule** · `warning` · on by default

Tools whose descriptions read almost the same get confused by models; make the distinction explicit.

A page rule judges the tool surface as a whole, so it needs a full snapshot: the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler, or `lint()` over a snapshot you collected yourself. Static analysis of a single `registerTool()` call cannot run it.

## Options

| Option      | Default |
| ----------- | ------- |
| `threshold` | `0.7`   |

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "similar-descriptions": false } }); // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "similar-descriptions": "warning" } }); // change severity
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "similar-descriptions": { threshold: 0.7 } } });
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule similar-descriptions=off
```
